text:
You need someone who can integrate ChatGPT into your web and business applications, keep the chatbot reliable, and work closely with your team to turn client requirements into a practical solution.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While my background is broader than AI alone, I’ve spent years building production software where reliability, integration, and maintainability matter just as much as the feature itself.

One example is a Monthly statement PDF generator for Alder Property Group. I built a Node.js queue that rendered owner statements to PDF overnight and stored them in S3 instead of generating them on request. That change handled 12k statements a month and took request timeouts from daily to none.

Another example is an End-to-end test suite for Kestrel Insurance. I built browser tests for the broker quoting flow that ran on every pull request. The suite covered 160 tests and reduced release regressions from 6 a quarter to 1.

Those projects reflect the same strengths your role needs: careful API-driven development, attention to edge cases, and the ability to work independently while keeping systems stable. If your team already has the product flow mapped out, I can help implement the ChatGPT integration cleanly into the existing application. If requirements are still evolving, I’m comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams to shape the chatbot behavior, data flow, and deployment approach.

I’m also used to working across the full stack, which is useful when AI features need to fit naturally into a web app rather than sit on top of it. I’d be glad to bring that perspective to your client work and help make the integration practical, maintainable, and easy for your team to support.

Could you share whether the ChatGPT integration is intended for an existing web application, or are you planning a new chatbot workflow from scratch?
